lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with narrower spacing observed near the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fourth line from the posterior, merging approximately 20% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two lines near the posterior and the most anterior line segment near the shoulder terminate mid-torso, failing to reach the ventral line of the body mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6-7 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally, and a secondary group of three spots forms a diagonal line segment descending towards the posterior knee.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, continuous dorsal stripe is visible from the base of the neck to the tail. Prominent white 'sock' markings are visible on the lower portions of all visible limbs above the black hooves.
